title: Air-Fryer Garlic Butter Prawns
subtitle: Garlic and butter prawns cooked in the air fryer in 6 minutes
excerpt: Large raw prawns tossed in garlic, melted butter, and lemon, cooked in the air fryer until pink and lightly charred at the edges. On the table in under 10 minutes.

recipe.sourceNotes: Garlic butter prawns appear in some form across Mediterranean, Spanish (gambas al ajillo), and French cuisines. The air fryer version produces a result similar to grill-cooked prawns: the dry heat chars the edges slightly and concentrates the garlic flavour. The speed of the air fryer suits prawns well because they only need 5 to 6 minutes total. Overcooked prawns become rubbery.

content.text: The prawns must be peeled and deveined before cooking. Prawns are done the moment they are pink all the way through and the tails have curled: this takes as little as 4 to 5 minutes. Check at 4 minutes and remove as soon as they are ready. Overcooked prawns are the most common mistake.
Preheat the air fryer to 200 C for 2 minutes. Mix the melted butter, garlic, lemon juice, chilli flakes if using, and salt together. Toss the prawns in the butter mixture.
Spread the prawns in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook at 200 C for 5 to 6 minutes until pink all the way through, checking at 4 minutes.
Scatter with chopped parsley. Serve immediately with crusty bread to mop up the butter, or over rice.
